engine.notes: Boston's scene re-centred after ImprovBoston closed: Improv Asylum downtown, Union Comedy in Somerville and the Rozzie Square Theater (home of ComedySportz Boston) in Roslindale now carry the class tracks. entries.name: Improv Asylum
entries.summary: Boston's long-running improv and sketch theatre on Hanover Street since 1997, with a Main Stage revue Wednesday to Saturday, Tuesday house-team nights and a six-level training center.
entries.schedule: Main Stage Wed-Sat; Raunch Saturdays; house teams Tuesdays; Level 1 sessions start Oct 3, 6, 13, 15 and 19, 2026
signals: Six improv levels, eight weeks each
House team auditions open after Level 3
Main Stage show Wednesday to Saturday
entries.reasons: Nearly thirty years in its own North End theatre, shows five nights a week, a six-level school with dated fall 2026 sessions and a clear path to house teams.

entries.name: The Rozzie Square Theater
entries.summary: Roslindale Village comedy theatre open since 2018 and home to ComedySportz Boston, with weekly improv, stand-up and storytelling shows, a free drop-in, an improv jam and a class ladder from Level 1A to 3B.
entries.schedule: Level 1A fall session Sep 16-Nov 4, 2026, Wednesdays 7-9pm, $310; Riot Improv first Saturdays 8:30pm
signals: Free drop-in and Improv Jam + Hangout
entries.reasons: Eight years in its own room with a full level ladder, a free drop-in and jam, and a dated fall 2026 session; its standing is local rather than regional.

entries.name: Union Comedy
entries.summary: Somerville's home for long-form improv: weekend shows by house teams and guest acts, a four-level school with eight-week sessions, indie team submissions and Card to Culture free admission.
entries.schedule: Weekend shows; Levels 1-4, eight weeks at 2.5 hours a week; house team auditions Sep 12-13, 2026
signals: House teams plus indie team submissions
Card to Culture free admission for EBT, WIC and ConnectorCare holders
entries.reasons: A dedicated long-form room with a complete beginner-to-house-team track and current auditions, but a younger institution whose public schedule pages are thin.

entries.name: The Nova Comedy Collective
entries.summary: Itinerant sketch, improv and stand-up collective producing The Nova Show at The Rockwell, a monthly Nebula Night improv jam at Arts at the Armory and Improv Gym drop-in classes at the Cambridge Foundry.
entries.schedule: Nebula Night monthly; Improv Gym on select Saturdays at The Foundry; classes tiered Launch, Orbit and Deep Space
signals: Improv Gym for all levels at The Cambridge Foundry
Three class tiers: Launch, Orbit, Deep Space
The Nova Show at The Rockwell, Somerville
entries.reasons: A lively but venue-less collective whose classes and jam are real and recurring, yet whose site shows tiers rather than dated sessions.

entries.name: Riot Theater Company
entries.summary: Improv company staging Riot Improv, a themed monthly special, on first Saturdays at The Rozzie Square Theater, with an audition-based 2026 team.
entries.schedule: First Saturday of the month, 8:30pm; monthly dates listed through December
signals: Monthly Riot Improv special, first Saturdays 8:30pm
Performs at The Rozzie Square Theater
Themed formats such as gAMepROv, aRTpROv and fILmpROv
entries.reasons: A surviving company with a monthly slot and current season dates, but no room of its own and no classes.
